reference: Elder 1993 Trading for a Living sections 43/47/48; daily-only long-side approximation, not verbatim reproduction

validation.multiple_testing: synchronized circular block bootstrap of excess returns versus RF; Holm adjustment for all72 and a centered max-mean family test

selection.allowed_information: 2022-2023 only; freeze selected IDs before generating/inspecting 2024-2025 candidate results
selection.balanced: training CAGR / max(training MDD, 0.01), maximize; ties higher net profit factor, then stable id
selection.high_win: highest training net win rate among eligible positive-return and profit-factor>1 candidates; if none, report none
selection.high_return: highest training cumulative return among eligible candidates
selection.not_untouched: All 2022-2025 market history previously inspected; chronological retrospective diagnostic only

assumptions: Only completed calendar weeks; entry/exit signals use prior session close
0.01 is an adjusted-price research buffer, not a reconstructed historical exchange tick
Initial stop is prior complete session low minus buffer; entry-day final low is never used at entry
Break-even activation at 1 entry-time ADR20; protection of 50/70 percent favorable price excursion; book provides principles, these precise thresholds are mechanical assumptions
Stop changes based on close-time information take effect next session; entry-day high is not assumed to occur after an intraday entry
1 percent planned sleeve equity risk including fees; no leverage; gaps may exceed planned risk
100 equal initial independent sleeves, no cross-stock capital sharing/rebalancing; idle cash rate initially zero and reported
Impulse, EFI3, ATR3, 70percent protection and exit combinations are research variants, not all original1993 rules
Long-only scope; does not test the book's short-side system or pyramiding
Current survivor universe, four already-viewed years, proportional friction and daily path ambiguity limit inference
